GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , held rails equal lead 700m, Headed soon after Straightening Up , she battled on well enough until last 100m when run ended # on pace/faded 100m
Jumped Ok , sat Just off Leaders heels 2 Lengths 800m, Ridden Along when Leader sprinted too after Straightening Up , weakened last 200m, visors first time # on pace/weakened
Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 2 lengths. under pressure turn. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping away. Raced keenly in the early stages. Tightened for room near teh 800m and was obliged to be restrained. At the entrance to the home straight improved onto the heels of another runner had to be steadied and shifted back to the inside to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & worked to share lead Two Wide early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pushed along @ 400m & pressured Four Wide @ 300m & weakened in last 200m. # Worked & weakened.

Began evenly. Niggled early & worked to share lead Two Wide early . Over-raced & stayed =lead Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pressured & headed @ 250m & faded in last 200m. # On-pace/weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced through the middle stages. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Pushed fwd & worked to lead on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside midrace & held together 3 Wide (2L clear) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 200m & held them in last 150m. # Worked/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped another runner on jumping away.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, quickly shaken up, battled on strong but no match leader/winner # 1 better/gap to 3rd
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped with another rnr. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly revealed no abnormalities. Inquiry into handling adjourned.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok to face breeze 1 length off, same turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little and kept on one pace # breeze/leader won
